descriptor: Keyboard-first workspace with a command palette

voice.summary: Writes like a good terminal: minimal, literal and quietly witty. Every word earns its keystroke, and keyboard hints are part of the sentence.
dos: Name actions as verbs a user would type
Show the shortcut alongside the label
Keep toast messages under six words
donts: Never explain a shortcut the user just used

taglines: The workspace that listens to your keys
boilerplate: Tabstop is a keyboard-first team workspace built around a command palette that finds any page, person or action in a couple of keystrokes.

microcopy.error: No such command. Try another word.
microcopy.empty: No recent commands. Press Cmd K to start.

logo.note: A bolt of lightning signals speed, the one promise a command palette makes.
